title: Flush spin, zero eccentric
terrain: flat road or trainer, no running, no descent, no stairs

steps.target: Z1-Z2 flat spin, high cadence, 70-80% LTHR

coachNotes: CUT 80 -> 25, AND THE RUN IS GONE. Yesterday came in at 289 against a planned 195. The trail run itself was not the overshoot, that was my arithmetic: 22.0km and 4h31 moving against 20.7km and 4h35 planned, so the route and the time were on the money and my load-per-minute coefficient was 22% low. The overshoot was the afternoon. The 6.6km hike with 511m of descent carrying a child, three and a half hours on emptied quads, is the highest ITB-risk thing that happened yesterday and it was in no plan. Plus the unlogged 30min bike, which has not synced and will add roughly 30 more when it does. WHERE THAT LEAVES YOU: CTL 45.4, ATL 79.9, TSB -34.5. Below the -30 line your own Friel reference calls the injury and illness danger zone, and the weekly ramp is 8.3 against a 6 cap, so both guardrails are breached this morning. Descent arithmetic: about 1480m from the run plus 511m from the hike is roughly 1990m yesterday, on top of Wednesday's 1206m, so about 3200m in four days. That is precisely the total I declined to prescribe on Friday when I held Saturday at 1400m instead of 2000m. You got there anyway, through the afternoon rather than the route. THERE IS NO FITNESS ARGUMENT FOR TRAINING TODAY. Full rest lands race-morning CTL at 44.2 and TSB +7.9, against a 42 target. This spin lands 44.6 and +8.1. Riding hard would land 45.4 and buy nothing you can use. The only thing today can still do for you is let tomorrow's numbers and the lateral knee read clean, and running on it muddies exactly that reading. WHY A SPIN RATHER THAN NOTHING: zero eccentric load, and it moves blood through quads that took 1990m of braking yesterday better than lying still does. If you wake up and the legs say no, take the rest instead. Both land in the same place, so pick by feel and do not overthink it. THE READ THAT MATTERS IS TOMORROW MORNING. ITB symptoms from a descent surface 24-48h later, which puts the real gate on Monday, mid-travel. No pain today is good and it is not yet the answer. Any lateral knee signal Monday or Tuesday and 5 September drops to one climb, and we take that quietly. NOT TODAY: no running, no descent, no stairs sessions, no carrying children downhill. Eat properly and sleep. 5.5h on Friday night into a 289-load day is the other half of why you feel dead.
